phase: Additional development, not confirmation; frozen before reading this cohort's scoring outcomes
baseline: Previously fixed public-first execution-consensus selection on four original candidates
trigger: One or more PUBLIC example assertions fail on the baseline-selected candidate
replacement: A new candidate replaces the baseline only if it passes strictly more public assertions; otherwise baseline is retained
prompt_source: Exact system and repair instruction from the completed 20-task pilot, with task specification, baseline-selected code and failed public assertions substituted; no task-specific analyst hints
seed_rule: sha256('transfer:20260908:{task_id}')[:8] interpreted as hex integer; same seed in all four arms
call_budget: Exactly one extra call per triggered task in each arm; zero on nontriggered tasks
failure_policy: No retries or budget extensions; incomplete reasoning yields empty failed code; all 40 task denominators retained
primary_development_comparison: Conditional reasoning resampling versus nonthinking resampling: accuracy plus measured extra cost, not a fixed-compute superiority claim
secondary_comparisons: Feedback versus resampling within each mode; all arms versus baseline; keep every arm even if it loses
reason_for_primary: 20-task pilot: reasoning resampling 17/20, reasoning feedback 16/20, nonthinking feedback 13/20, nonthinking resampling and baseline 12/20. This adaptive choice is disclosed.
